verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents managing flags, experiments, and deployments "from CI, scripts, or your own tools" through the Experiment APIs. A broad set of programmatic REST surfaces also supports headless automation: HTTP V2 ingestion, event export, the Dashboard REST API returning JSON, cohort and taxonomy CRUD, and a probed OpenAPI spec. The Wizard CLI adds a terminal-driven setup path, though it is aimed at one-time instrumentation rather than ongoing CI jobs. Missing for 10: a general-purpose headless CLI beyond the setup wizard, CI-specific guidance (auth, pipeline examples) outside the Experiment APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
